subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region scheduling
messages:
From: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@globex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Schmidt <oliver.schmidt@globex.eu>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@globex.apac>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region scheduling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier — we'd love to get a demo scheduled with our platform, product, and exec stakeholders. We're coordinating folks across US / EU / APAC and want to pick a time that works for all. A few constraints:

- US (PST): our product lead Amy is available mornings (9–11 PT) most days.
- EU (CEST): Oliver is +9 hours ahead of PT and prefers afternoons (14:00–17:00 CEST).
- APAC (SG/HKT): Sanjay is available late evenings our time (23:00–01:00 PT) but early morning their time (11:00–13:00 SGT).

Proposed broad windows (please confirm conversions):
- Option A: 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT / 18:00 CEST / 01:00 SGT next day
- Option B: 12:00 UTC / 05:00 PT / 14:00 CEST / 21:00 SGT
- Option C (exec-friendly): 08:00 UTC / 01:00 PT / 10:00 CEST / 17:00 SGT

Do any of these line up for your team? Also can you confirm whether we should include any execs from your side (we'll loop in ours afterwards). Note: we saw a lot of DST juggling this year so if you have preferred timezone formatting (e.g., specifying UTC) that helps.

Thanks — happy to use your Calendly link if that’s easier.

Best,
Emma Barnes
Head of Product Partnerships
Globex Corp
emma.barnes@globex.com

Attachment: stakeholder_list.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@globex.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region scheduling

Hi Emma — thanks for the context and the options. Copying Jonas and Rishi so they can confirm exec availability on our side.

Quick notes on the windows you shared (converted and with some additional balanced options):
- Option A: 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT / 18:00 CEST / 01:00 SGT (+1) — will be late for APAC attendees.
- Option B: 12:00 UTC / 05:00 PT / 14:00 CEST / 21:00 SGT — early for US, good for EU/APAC.
- Option C: 08:00 UTC / 01:00 PT / 10:00 CEST / 17:00 SGT — hard for US execs.

Our suggested balanced slots (all in UTC with common conversions):
- Slot 1: 13:00 UTC / 06:00 PT / 15:00 CEST / 22:00 SGT (best for EU/APAC; US product lead can join early)
- Slot 2: 15:00 UTC / 08:00 PT / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 SGT (+1) (works if APAC can do late night)
- Slot 3: 19:00 UTC / 12:00 PT / 21:00 CEST / 04:00 SGT (+1) (US midday, EU late evening — not ideal for APAC)

Can you run these by your stakeholders? I’ve attached a draft demo agenda to help surface which execs should join. If Calendly is preferred, please share a link and we’ll pick a time there.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: demo_agenda_draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@globex.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 07:20:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region scheduling

Hi all — quick note from my side: the EU exec (VP Product) prefers afternoon CEST and is unlikely to join before 15:00 CEST. Also flag on DST: the US/EU offset right now is 7 hours (PT to CET) but that flips sometimes depending on local DST — I recommend we anchor on UTC in invites.

Given that, I think Slot 1 (13:00 UTC) could work if the US product lead agrees to a 06:00 PT start (I know that’s early). If that’s not acceptable, we should aim for 15:00 UTC which is 08:00 PT and 17:00 CEST — tolerable across the board.

I’m attaching a quick availability sheet for our execs (shows 08:00–10:00 PT windows and a separate 15:00–17:00 CEST window).

Jonas

Attachment: exec_availability.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@globex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Schmidt <oliver.schmidt@globex.eu>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@globex.apac>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — multi-region scheduling

Thanks Jonas — that makes sense. We polled our group and the preferred slot is 15:00 UTC / 08:00 PT / 17:00 CEST. Sanjay from APAC can join at 00:00 SGT (late night) for that slot — not ideal but doable.

Preferred: 15:00 UTC on Monday 2026-06-15
Backup: 13:00 UTC on Tuesday 2026-06-16

If you can confirm execs on your end (Marissa/Jonas/Rishi/Vivek), I’ll send calendar invites from our side after you confirm.

Cheers,
Emma

--
Emma Barnes
Head of Product Partnerships, Globex Corp
